aws4fetch.review: Dependency-free MIT WebCrypto signer documented by Cloudflare for R2. Inventory uses sign() with s3/auto and one explicit fetch, manual redirects, bounded response and timeout; AwsClient.fetch retries are not used.

unicode-case-folding.review: Dependency-free MIT ESM. All 1585 mappings and unmapped codepoints matched official Unicode 17.0.0 C/F case folding. Official CaseFolding.txt SHA256 ff8d8fefbf123574205085d6714c36149eb946d717a0c585c27f0f4ef58c4183.

jose.review: Dependency-free ESM/WebCrypto implementation; upstream supports Cloudflare Workers. JWT verification tested in Node and workerd.

fast-xml-parser.review: MIT ESM parser selected after the seven-day release cutoff. DAV uses preserveOrder with entity processing disabled, rejects DTD/entity declarations and XInclude, and enforces independent byte, depth, element, attribute, namespace and property budgets.
